Welcome! I am an MRes/Doctoral Researcher at the Department of Government at the <a href="https://www.lse.ac.uk/government/" target="_blank">London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)</a>. I am affiliated with the [LSE Data Science Institute](https://www.lse.ac.uk/dsi) and the [Grantham Research Institute on Climate Change and the Environment](https://www.lse.ac.uk/granthaminstitute/). My research focuses on the distributive and political impacts of sustainable urban policies.

Before starting my PhD, I worked as a Research Assistant at <a href="https://ieb.ub.edu/en/" target="_blank">Barcelona's Institute of Economics (IEB)</a> and the <a href="https://www.uoc.edu/en" target="_blank">Open University of Catalonia (UOC)</a>.

I hold a <a href="https://www.lse.ac.uk/study-at-lse/graduate/msc-political-science-political-science-and-political-economy" target="_blank">Master's degree in Political Science and Political Economy</a> from LSE, a <a href="https://www.upf.edu/en/web/graus/grau-filosofia-politica-economia" target="_blank">Bachelor's in Philosophy, Politics and Economics</a> from Pompeu Fabra University, and training in <a href="https://web.ub.edu/en/web/estudis/w/specificmasterdegree-202311953" target="_blank">Data Analysis for Social Sciences</a> from the University of Barcelona.

---

### Research
